lead: Nitin Gadkari is an Indian politician, born on 27 May 1957 in Nagpur.
As of 2026, he is 69 years old, and his birth date places him under the Gemini sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Maharashtra Legislature and Member of the 16th Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Nitin facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Nitin Gadkari — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Nitin Gadkari was born on 27 May 1957 in Nagpur, and holds Indian nationality.
He received his education at Rashtrasant Tukadoji Maharaj Nagpur University.

sections.heading: Nitin Gadkari — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Maharashtra Legislature (1990–2014), Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Member of the 17th Lok Sabha, Minister of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (2019–2021), Minister of Road Transport and Highways (2014–present) and Minister of Shipping (India) (2014–2019). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
He has taken part in World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2017.
